fixture.description: Vite and Vitest project managed with pnpm. The README tells people to run npm start, but package.json has no start script (the dev script is dev), and CI uses pnpm. The map should name pnpm and Vitest and flag the stale README.

files.README.md:
# Dashboard

Install with `npm install`, then run `npm start` to open the app.
files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test

name = "invoicer"
version = "0.3.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["httpx>=0.27", "typer>=0.12"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8", "ruff>=0.6"]

[project.scripts]
invoicer = "invoicer.cli:app"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
files.CLAUDE.md:
# Conventions
- Use httpx for HTTP, never requests.
- All money values are integers in cents, never floats.
- New CLI commands get a test in tests/test_cli.py.

from typer.testing import CliRunner

from invoicer.cli import app


def test_total():
    result = CliRunner().invoke(app, ["100", "250"])
    assert result.output.strip() == "350"
